name: launchproof
description: Launchproof: test a business idea before you spend on it

plugins.name: launchproof
plugins.description: Fifteen Claude skills that take a business idea from the first founder questions to a gated business plan: founder fit, the IdeaGauge score, a five-member board, a red team, competitors, a 100-buyer simulated panel, pricing, the offer, a CFO, marketing, brand, operations, a real-world test and the 14-step Startup Blueprint.
